version_scope.note: Official VDV-Schrift 301-2-17 HTMLDisplayService V2.1 is the profile authority. The exact VDV-301-2.1 release inventory contains no dedicated HDS service XSD by design. Discovery uses _http._tcp with TXT content+path; the content endpoint is built from SRV target/port plus TXT path.

Official HTMLDisplayService V2.2 is a non-XSD DNS-SD/HTTP profile. Canonical discovery uses _http._tcp with TXT content+url; the content endpoint comes from TXT url rather than reconstructing it from SRV host/port.

Official amended/corrected V2.2a publication is normative for this HDS profile variant even though no dedicated VDV-301-2.2a repository tag exists. Both _http._tcp and _ibisip_http._tcp are recognised; _http._tcp is deprecated/future-not-recommended and _ibisip_http._tcp is the documented transition/future label. TXT remains content+url.

semantic_basis.note: The byte-pinned V2.1, V2.2 and V2.2a publications establish HDS as a DNS-SD/HTTP/browser profile without its own service protocol/XSD and define the version-specific discovery fields and endpoint rules.

EV-151 checked the exact VDV-301-2.1 and VDV-301-2.2 release inventories and the 50-root integration pool; none contains a dedicated HTMLDisplayService service XSD. V2.2a has no dedicated release tag.
The V2.2/V2.2a source history preserves the transition from V2.1 content+path endpoint construction to content+url and, in V2.2a, the non-exclusive transition toward _ibisip_http._tcp.
RV-002 rerun in EV-151 passes and deterministically verifies the V2.1, V2.2 and V2.2a discovery/endpoint rules without making live DNS/mDNS, HTTP reachability or browser-interoperability claims.

Because the official profile explicitly uses DNS-SD/HTTP and exact release inventories contain no HDS XSD, treating the absent service XSD as a missing-schema defect would invent an XML contract and select the wrong validation lane.

de.title: HTMLDisplayService: absichtlich kein eigener Service-XSD-Vertrag
de.short: Für HTMLDisplayService ist kein eigener Service-XSD vorgesehen; die Prüfung erfolgt versionsabhängig über das DNS-SD/HTTP-Profil.
de.long: HDS-001 ist kein Schemafehler. Die offiziellen Publikationen für V2.1, V2.2 und V2.2a beschreiben HTMLDisplayService als DNS-SD/HTTP-/Browser-Profil ohne eigenen Service-XSD-Vertrag. EV-151 bestätigt zusätzlich, dass die exakten V2.1- und V2.2-Release-Inventare sowie der 50-XSD-Integrationspool keinen dedizierten HDS-XSD enthalten. Die Versionen dürfen nicht nach dem Latest-Wins-Prinzip vereinheitlicht werden: V2.1 nutzt _http._tcp mit content+path und bildet den Endpunkt aus SRV-Ziel/Port plus TXT-path; V2.2 nutzt kanonisch _http._tcp mit content+url und übernimmt den Endpunkt aus TXT-url; V2.2a erkennt zusätzlich _ibisip_http._tcp als Übergangs-/Zukunftsbezeichnung an, während _http._tcp weiterhin akzeptiert, aber als deprecated bzw. zukünftig nicht mehr empfohlen gekennzeichnet ist.
de.recommendation: Beim ausgewählten HTMLDisplayService-Profil keine fehlende Service-XSD melden und keinen XML-Vertrag ableiten. Stattdessen den versionsgenauen HDS-DNS-SD/HTTP-Validator verwenden und V2.1-, V2.2- und V2.2a-Regeln getrennt anwenden.

en.title: HTMLDisplayService: intentionally no dedicated service XSD contract
en.short: HTMLDisplayService intentionally has no dedicated service XSD; validation is performed through its version-specific DNS-SD/HTTP profile.
en.long: HDS-001 is not a schema defect. The official V2.1, V2.2 and V2.2a publications define HTMLDisplayService as a DNS-SD/HTTP/browser profile without a dedicated service XSD contract. EV-151 additionally confirms that the exact V2.1 and V2.2 release inventories and the 50-root integration XSD pool contain no dedicated HDS XSD. The versions must not be collapsed using a latest-wins rule: V2.1 uses _http._tcp with content+path and constructs the endpoint from the SRV target/port plus TXT path; V2.2 canonically uses _http._tcp with content+url and takes the endpoint from TXT url; V2.2a additionally recognises _ibisip_http._tcp as the documented transition/future label while _http._tcp remains accepted but deprecated/future-not-recommended.
en.recommendation: For a selected HTMLDisplayService profile, do not report a missing service XSD and do not invent an XML contract. Route to the version-specific HDS DNS-SD/HTTP validator and keep the V2.1, V2.2 and V2.2a rules separate.

candidate_triggers: selected service is HTMLDisplayService and selected profile version is 2.1, 2.2, or 2.2a
service validation is being routed and no dedicated HDS service XSD exists by design
apply tools/runtime_discovery_profile.py check_html_display with the exact selected HDS version instead of an XML service-XSD lane

source_references.note: Terminal HDS revalidation report; HDS-001 is context_verified and explicitly classified as an intentional non-XSD DNS-SD/HTTP profile.

entries.notes: Confirmed intentional non-XSD service model. No HDS XML alias, hidden schema contract, or latest-version backport is created. Runtime mapping is reviewed as a routing rule to the existing DNS-SD/HTTP profile checker, not as an implemented SDK finding diagnostic.
